title: Grateful Dead Live at Rose Palace on 1969-05-10
lineage: mC > C > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with decent overall sound; early filler is weak but the Dark Star, The Eleven, and Turn‑On‑Your‑Lovelight deliver a spectacular second half.
ai_review.review: The show is hampered by an uneven first six tracks and some equipment glitches (power cuts, digi noise), but once the band gets rolling the performance soars. A sparkling 20‑minute Dark Star, a monster The Eleven, and a soaring Turn‑On‑Your‑Lovelight make this a must‑listen despite occasional sound deterioration in the latter part of Dark Star.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the core jams (Dark Star, The Eleven, Lovelight) and rate the recording as good, while noting only moderate flaws in early filler and occasional noise; weighted average yields a strong >4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard mix with occasional digi noise around the 18‑minute mark of Dark Star and noticeable deterioration after ~12 minutes; some early‑set equipment problems (power cutouts) but overall listenable.

poor_songs: First six tracks (early filler, e.g., Hey Little One, Hard To Handle, etc.)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert starts with a long stretch of filler and technical hiccups, but after the power outages the band launches into an inspired second half where the jams build and sustain high energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone is praised (amp turned up loud, vibrant voice, powerful soloing especially on Dark Star and Lovelight).
